context: After class. Sakura has been worrying about university entrance exams and has finally asked Ms. Asuka for a quiet talk.
purpose: teen / teacher career consultation — adolescent uncertainty meeting professional patience

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先生、ちょっと相談いいですか。
lines.en: Sensei, can I talk to you for a bit?
lines.style: Teen voice softer than her bright default, the careful asking already showing the weight she's carrying inside.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: もちろん。座って、ゆっくり話して。
lines.en: Of course. Sit down, talk slowly.
lines.style: Teacher warm professional opening, the space being made audible in the deliberate pacing and gentle welcome.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 進路のことで、ずっと迷ってて。
lines.en: About my future path — I've been stuck for a while.
lines.style: Teen vulnerability surfacing, voice quieter than usual, real anxiety threaded under the careful self-disclosure delivered.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.style: Teacher quiet listening register, the brief response opening more space, professional warmth radiating gently.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 何が得意なのか、自分でもわからなくて。
lines.en: I don't even know what I'm good at, myself.
lines.style: Teen genuine confusion voice, the self-doubt unhidden, real searching audible in the soft honest delivery.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: さくらさんは、何をしてる時が楽しい？
lines.en: Sakura — when are you having fun?
lines.style: Teacher careful pivot toward the question that matters, professional skill in reframing the harder question gently.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 本を読んでる時、かな…。あと、誰かに教える時。
lines.en: When I'm reading, maybe… And when I'm teaching someone.
lines.style: Teen tentative real answer, voice loosening with the actual truth surfacing, soft genuine reflection throughout.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: なるほど。それ、すごく大事な情報だよ。
lines.en: I see. That's really important information.
lines.style: Teacher warm professional validation, the casual word 「情報」 treating her answer with respect, soft real care.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: でも、夢って、もっと立派なものじゃないですか。
lines.en: But — aren't dreams supposed to be more impressive things?
lines.style: Teen vulnerable comparison surfacing, the smallness of her actual interests felt acutely, real worry threaded throughout.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そんなことない。本当に好きなものが、一番強い。
lines.en: Not at all. What you truly love is the strongest.
lines.style: Teacher firm gentle conviction, the principle held with deep experience, soft real authority in the delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Single teen vulnerable check, the question almost a whisper, soft hope rising audibly underneath the brevity.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 本当に。先生も、教えるのが好きだから、今ここにいる。
lines.en: Truly. I love teaching, that's why I'm here.
lines.style: Teacher personal disclosure offered carefully, the credibility of her own path joined to the advice given.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: …そっか。なんか、少し気持ちが楽になりました。
lines.en: …I see. Somehow, my feeling got a little lighter.
lines.style: Teen visible relief lifting, voice loosening with real release, soft genuine gratitude threading through the response.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: まだ時間あるから、焦らないで。
lines.en: There's still time, so don't rush.
lines.style: Teacher soft closing reassurance, the time-pressure laid down gently, real care in the pacing throughout.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。先生、ありがとうございました。
lines.en: Yes. Sensei, thank you so much.
lines.style: Teen sincere weighted thanks, voice carrying the real lifting the conversation has produced, soft deep gratitude.
